testPolicy.text: Continuing for the 2027 application cycle, U-M will be test-optional. Applicants choose whether SAT/ACT scores are considered; self-reported scores are accepted (official scores required on enrollment) and U-M superscores. ED/EA applicants who want scores considered must self-report them by Nov. 1. Not submitting is stated to be no disadvantage.
testPolicy.since: test-optional since fall 2021 entry, renewed for fall 2027 entry

cost.totalIncludes: Full-time undergraduate, fall and winter terms, lower division (0-54 credits), LSA rates: tuition and fees + living expenses (unlimited basic residential meal plan) + books, course materials, supplies and equipment + transportation + miscellaneous personal. Upper division (55+ credits): tuition and fees 21,268 in-state (total 42,566) and 71,798 out-of-state (total 93,096). Health insurance not listed.

inState.note: Financial aid page gives tuition and fees combined (18,896); the split 18,402 + 494 is from CDS 2025-26 G1 (2026-27 figures)

outOfState.note: Tuition and fees 67,096 on the financial aid page; split from CDS G1; international students pay an additional 1,000 required fee per CDS G1

aidPromise.text: Go Blue Guarantee: free tuition for up to four years for qualified high-achieving, in-state, full-time undergraduate students; Michigan families with incomes of $125,000 and under and assets below $125,000 qualify.

deadlines.early: November 1 (Early Decision, binding, decision by Dec. 24, commitment Jan. 6; Early Action, nonbinding, decision by Jan. 29)

facts.text: Michigan now offers binding Early Decision (deadline Nov. 1, decision by Dec. 24) alongside Early Action; the CDS 2025-26 shows no Early Decision plan for the fall 2025 class, so ED is new.
In-state families with income of $125,000 or less and assets below $125,000 qualify for free tuition under the Go Blue Guarantee.
Out-of-state students pay 67,096 in 2026-27 tuition and fees (lower division) against 18,896 for Michigan residents, for totals of 88,394 and 40,194.
Tuition rises once a student reaches upper division (55+ credits): 21,268 in-state and 71,798 out-of-state in 2026-27.
For fall 2025, 18,435 applicants accepted a place on the waiting list and 1,663 were admitted from it.
For fall 2027 entry, the advance selection process for computer science has been removed and the School of Public Health becomes a preferred admission option through LSA.

notes: Cycle from CDS 2025-26 C1 (53,044 + 56,068 = 109,112 applied; 7,593 + 10,322 = 17,915 admitted; 3,499 + 4,679 = 8,178 enrolled). C1 residency breakdown left blank by U-M. No official fall 2026 class numbers found. Finaid and admissions pages block curl (HTTP 403) and were read in Chrome. CDS G1 2026-27: in-state tuition 18,402 / 19,588 and out-of-state 66,602 / 68,953 (two columns, likely lower/upper division in LSA) with required fees 494; the financial aid page's tuition-and-fees figures differ for upper division (21,268 / 71,798), so the financial aid page totals are used. The Ann Arbor-specific Go Blue Guarantee page (finaid.umich.edu/go-blue-guarantee) redirects to the system page cited; academic merit conditions are not detailed there.
